# College students, pitch your business idea for a chance to win $30,000!

By Team Fetch

February 1, 2026

## Welcome to the Third Annual Defeat the Odds Pitch Competition!

Fetch invites student entrepreneurs enrolled in colleges and universities across the United States to pitch their ideas for the opportunity to win up to $30,000 in prize money, receive one-on-one mentorship, access Fetch office space, and participate in lunch-and-learn sessions with Fetch’s Legal, Accounting, and Marketing teams.

## What is the Defeat the Odds Pitch Competition?

The Defeat the Odds Pitch Competition is a platform for college entrepreneurs to share their business ideas for the opportunity to pitch to a panel of judges and compete for cash prizes. The competition is designed to give students hands-on learning experiences, including honing pitch skills, thinking critically about business models, and harnessing innovation.

In addition to the opportunity to win cash prizes, finalists receive mentorship from Fetch leaders to help them prepare for a live pitch experience. Finalists will be flown to Boston to pitch in person, with travel and lodging fully covered by Fetch, providing direct exposure to industry professionals and real-world pitch experience.

## Apply for a WECode 2026 Scholarship

#### Scholarship applications are OPEN.

We are dedicated to making WECode accessible to everyone. 

Over the past few years, we've been developing efforts to make our conference as inclusive as possible, and we're grateful to all parties that have enabled us to work towards this ongoing initiative. For the 2026 WECode Conference, we are excited to announce that we're expanding our impact and offering a generous scholarship that will help make the in-person WECode experience possible to more prospective attendees.

The WECode 2027 scholarship covers the full cost of the conference ticket priced at our early bird ticket rate, and provides financial aid for travel and other related expenses. This award amount totaling to $200 will go towards your WECode conference ticket purchase AND related transportation expenses (including but not limited to flight cost, additional food, transportation, etc.). 

These scholarships are limited, and will be distributed to those who 

1. are in the most financial need, and 
2. would benefit the most from the in-person conference experience (demonstrated by essay responses). 

Please note, if you are accepted as a WECode Tech Fellow, your scholarship award amount of $200 excludes the price of the WECode conference ticket as all tech fellows receive free admission to the event. # 2026-2027 NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship

#### Description

The NRF Foundation Ray Greenly Scholarship Fund offers the opportunity for technology and supply chain students to attend the 2027 NRF NXT (formerly called NRF Foundation Student Program) in New York City, free of charge. Retail companies, including some of the most exciting brands in the country, are driving big tech innovation. 

 

The NRF Foundation Student Program introduces exciting career paths that might not have been considered, with sessions highlighting the impact tech, supply chain, fulfillment, and data and analytics jobs have on retail businesses.

 

Undergraduate college students pursuing a technology major (computer science, engineering, data science, etc.) or a supply chain major, you could be eligible to receive FREE travel and hotel accommodations to attend the annual NRF Foundation Student Program in New York City.

 

By attending this conference, you will have the opportunity to meet with dozens of retail recruiters hiring for technology and supply chain roles, hear from top leaders and executives in the industry, and explore the most exciting store locations in NYC.

#### Qualifications

• Undergraduate-level sophomore, junior or senior

• Currently pursuing a technology or supply chain major

• Enrolled full-time at an accredited college or university in the United States

• Minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale

• At least one job or internship related to your field of study or area(s)

ATC 2026: The 2026 ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference

# ATC 2026

## ATC 2026 Student Scholarships and Travel Grants

ATC 2026 offers a limited number of grants to help full-time undergraduate and graduate students attend the conference in Hong Kong. Students may apply whether or not they are presenting work.

Funding is competitive and may cover conference registration and part of reasonable travel and accommodation expenses. Awards may not cover all requested costs.

### Eligibility

Applicants must:

- be enrolled full-time at an accredited institution;
- study computer science, computer engineering, or a related field;
- attend ATC 2026 in person if selected; and
- disclose all confirmed or pending funding for the trip.

Postdoctoral researchers are also eligible.

### Application Materials

Please submit:

- the completed application form;
- a CV of no more than two pages;
- proof of current full-time student status.

Applications will be evaluated based on financial need, relevance to ATC, expected benefit from attending, available institutional support, and contributions to broad participation.

### Important Dates

Late or incomplete applications may not be considered.

The LLVM Foundation is committed to diversity and education in the fields of compilers and tools, and supporting the long term health and growth of the LLVM Project. Therefore, the LLVM Foundation provides travel grants to students attending the LLVM Developers’ Meetings or other compilers and tools related educational conferences.

Applications are open for student travel grants to attend the 2026 LLVM Developers’ Meeting taking place October 27 - 28, 2026 (pre-conference sessions on October 26) at the Santa Clara Marriott.

The deadline for 2026 LLVM Dev Mtg applications is July 17, 2026.

- Priority may be given to underrepresented backgrounds, genders, and experiences to encourage broader participation in computer science and engineering.
